### Contributing guidelines

- [X] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [X] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version

### Module(s)

mini.completion, mini.notify

### Description

I have min.notify configured like so:

```
now(function()
  require('mini.notify').setup()
	vim.notify = require('mini.notify').make_notify()
end)
```

And I have mini.completion configured like so:

```
later(function() require('mini.completion').setup({
	-- high delay basically means 'no auto popups'
  delay = { completion = 10^7, info = 10^7, signature = 10^7 },
 	-- Way of how module does LSP completion
  lsp_completion = {
    -- `source_func` should be one of 'completefunc' or 'omnifunc'.
    source_func = 'completefunc',
  },
}) end)
```

Now, unless I remove the setting of `vim.notify`, when I trigger completion in my C project with clangd I consistently get this error:

```
E5108: Error executing lua .../nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/notify.lua:683: E565: Not allowed to change text or change window                                                                                         
stack traceback:                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
        [C]: in function 'nvim_buf_set_lines'                                                                                                                                                                                         
        .../nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/notify.lua:683: in function 'buffer_refresh'                                                                                                                                 
        .../nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/notify.lua:417: in function 'refresh'                                                                                                                                        
        .../nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/notify.lua:331: in function 'add'                                                                                                                                            
        .../nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/notify.lua:293: in function 'notify'                                                                                                                                         
        vim/_editor.lua: in function 'notify_once'                                                                                                                                                                                    
        /usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/util.lua:1998: in function '_get_offset_encoding'                                                                                                                                         
        /usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/util.lua:1967: in function 'make_position_params'                                                                                                                                         
        ...m/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/completion.lua:340: in function <...m/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/completion.lua:325>
```



### Neovim version

NVIM v0.10.0-dev+2324-g4948fa42e

### Steps to reproduce

1. Define the config as above
2. Open a C/CPP project which uses clangd
3. Try to trigger completion


### Expected behavior

Completion is shown

### Actual behavior

An error is encountered.

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the issue!

Unfortunately, I can not reproduce. I used the following 'init.lua' which was run as fresh config with the help of `NVIM_APPNAME`:

<details><summary>Custom '~/.config/nvim-clangd/init.lua'</summary>

```lua
-- Clone 'mini.nvim' manually in a way that it gets managed by 'mini.deps'
local path_package = vim.fn.stdpath("data") .. "/site/"
local mini_path = path_package .. "pack/deps/start/mini.nvim"
if not vim.loop.fs_stat(mini_path) then
	vim.cmd('echo "Installing `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
	local clone_cmd = { "git", "clone", "--filter=blob:none", "https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim", mini_path }
	vim.fn.system(clone_cmd)
	vim.cmd("packadd mini.nvim | helptags ALL")
	vim.cmd('echo "Installed `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
end

-- Set up 'mini.deps' (customize to your liking)
require("mini.deps").setup({ path = { package = path_package } })

-- Use 'mini.deps'. `now()` and `later()` are helpers for a safe two-stage
-- startup and are optional.
local add, now, later = MiniDeps.add, MiniDeps.now, MiniDeps.later

now(function()
	require("mini.notify").setup()
	vim.notify = require("mini.notify").make_notify()
end)

later(function()
	require("mini.completion").setup({
		-- high delay basically means 'no auto popups'
		delay = { completion = 10 ^ 7, info = 10 ^ 7, signature = 10 ^ 7 },
		-- Way of how module does LSP completion
		lsp_completion = {
			-- `source_func` should be one of 'completefunc' or 'omnifunc'.
			source_func = "completefunc",
		},
	})
end)

vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('FileType', {
  pattern = 'c',
  callback = function()
    vim.lsp.start({
      name = 'clangd',
      cmd = { 'clangd' }, -- Custom path to 'clangd' executable
      root_dir = '.',
    })
  end,
})
```

</details>

- I then ran `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-clangd nvim` once (version is `NVIM v0.10.0-dev-2457+ga4b444252`) so that it installs everything. Closed it.
- Navigated to Neovim's repo root and again executed `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-clangd nvim`.
- Ran `:edit src/nvim/buffer.c`.
- Navigated to first empty line, started Insert mode, typed `s` followed by `<C-Space>` (to show completion menu). And it showed completions from `clangd` without any errors.

------

I am honestly not quite sure how this error could even come up. What I'd suggest verifying:
- Update to latest Nightly and try to reproduce the error.
- How do you open file to edit? If it is `nvim -- my-file.c`, then due to using `later()` to set up 'mini.completion', it is not setting 'completefunc' at the first buffer. I've encountered that but still did not see any error, it was only showing completion from fallback source.

Well, then I don't think this is an issue with 'mini.nvim'.

For now, closing as not related to 'mini.nvim'. If you happen to reproduce this without 'zbirenbaum/copilot.lua', let me know here.
Fair enough :) I'll do a like digging as to why these errors bubble up in mini.completion

title: mini.completion breaks when mini.notify overwrites vim.notify function
